article.story: TOLEDO, Ohio -- — Leroy Blyden Jr.'s 15 points, eight assists and six rebounds helped Toledo defeat Eastern Michigan 94-75 on Saturday. Sonny Wilson also scored 15 points, going 7 of 11 from the field for the Rockets (14-13, 8-6 Mid-American Conference). Sean Craig went 5 of 8 from the field to finish with 13 points. Mohammad Habhab led the Eagles (10-18, 4-11) in scoring, finishing with 21 points, nine rebounds and seven assists. Mehki added 12 points and two steals for Eastern Michigan. Mak Manciel also had eight points. Toledo took the lead 29 seconds into the game and did not trail again. Wilson led the Rockets with nine points in the first half to help put them up 51-29 at the break. Toledo extended its lead to 60-32 during the second half, fueled by a 9-0 scoring run. Craig scored a team-high nine points in the second half. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
